prompt_en: Make a photorealistic natural image inside a lived-in indoor bouldering gym. She wears a gray hoodie loosely layered over a visible white cropped T-shirt with black denim jeans. She sits on a climbing-gym bench, leaning forward to readjust and fasten one climbing shoe; her relaxed gaze follows the strap in her fingers, the other shoe resting on rubber flooring. Capture an unposed everyday snapshot with polished young-pop-star styling from an asymmetrical three-quarter angle that keeps her face, hands, and climbing shoes readable in one frame. Use the imperfect look of a handheld iPhone snapshot, with a slight off-level tilt, natural auto-exposure, and the nearby viewpoint of a friend catching the moment before she looks up. Mixed cool ceiling light and faint warm lobby spill reveal realistic skin and worn fabric. Climbing holds, chalk marks, cubbies, and scattered gear sit softly behind her. Finish with muted indoor color, gentle motion softness, subtle film grain and an off-guard, quietly observed candid mood.
